title: OmniWeaving Unified Video Generation Model
summary: A unified video generation framework by Tencent Hunyuan that integrates a Multimodal Large Language Model for reasoning-enhanced synthesis. It supports interleaved text, image, and video inputs for complex multimodal composition and editing.
research_notes: Released alongside the IntelligentVBench benchmark; restricted by a community license that limits usage in certain regions including the EU and UK.

evolution.summary: Successor to HunyuanVideo (Dec 2024) and HunyuanVideo-1.5 (Nov 2025). It introduces a 'Thinking Mode' for intelligent prompt reasoning and unified capabilities across text-to-video, image-to-video, and video editing tasks.
